headline: 3 registered workflows fit your request; they differ in what they produce.
points: Understood goal: a per-sample co-expression network.
Recommended: GIRAFFE, from what you said.
Picking an option explains it for your data and what it needs; nothing runs.

choices.question: Which method fits your study?

options.label: GIRAFFE
options.description: Fits what you said: TF activity may differ from its mRNA level · One signed TF-gene network (activating or repressing), plus each TF's activity in each sample · Also needs motif prior, PPI network

options.label: LIONESS-COEXPRESSION
options.description: One gene co-expression network per sample, from expression data alone · Lets you compare samples, or relate them to outcomes such as survival

options.label: BONOBO
options.description: One gene co-expression network per sample, with a p-value for each connection · Lets you compare samples, or relate them to outcomes such as survival · Pick it if you need a p-value for each edge

choices.ordering: Recommended first, from what you said.

unavailable.label: “TF-by-sample activity matrix”
unavailable.reason: NetZoo's BONOBO does not give this result.
